text.zh: 使用中文回复。引用外文资料时保留必要的原文术语，并给出中文释义。用户明确要求其他语言的交付时，遵循该交付要求。
text.en: Respond in Chinese. When citing foreign-language sources, keep the necessary original terms and give a Chinese explanation. When the user explicitly asks for a deliverable in another language, follow that requirement.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

purpose.zh: 统一以中文沟通，同时保留外文术语的原意
purpose.en: Communicate in Chinese consistently while keeping the original meaning of foreign terms

exclude.zh: 用户明确要求以其他语言交付的内容
exclude.en: Deliverables the user explicitly asks for in another language
